text:
sophie (idp-admin): quick heads up — seeing a bunch of new user signups fail JIT provisioning for the rewritten RBAC schema. errors show missing attribute 'team_scope'. @maya @tom :eyes:

sophie (idp-admin): sample SAML attrs we get from Okta for affected users:
```xml
<Attribute Name=\"roles\">
  <AttributeValue>editor</AttributeValue>
  <AttributeValue>payments-team</AttributeValue>
</Attribute>
<!-- no Attribute named 'team_scope' -->
```

sophie (idp-admin): previously our mapping accepted group-derived roles only; the refactor expects explicit `team_scope` attribute to map to scoped roles. if absent, provisioning fails instead of falling back.

maya (security): ugh. that explains the spike in support requests. do we have any cases where a user got escalated privileges because of the mapping change? :lock:

tom (infra): quick check — one service account login did get `team:payments:admin` while it should have been `team:payments:viewer`. looks like the mapping used `contains` on the group claim and matched `payments-admins` -> admin. logging snippet:
```
2026-11-15T08:12:03Z INFO rbac: map_result user=srv-deploy-01 matched_group=payments-admins assigned_role=team:payments:admin method=okta-saml
```

sophie (idp-admin): thanks — that's the risky bit. Okta rule was supposed to do exact matches but a recent change switched to substring matching when we added support for legacy group strings.

oliver (oncall): mitigation idea: revert the Okta App mapping to exact-match only and flip the JIT service into "lenient mode" that maps groups to viewer roles (no admin) until we patch. can someone flip the app setting? @sophie

sophie (idp-admin): I can roll that back now — will set to exact-match and add a unit test for the mapping template. doing it in the staging app first.

maya (security): also recommend we add a short-lived admission check in the RBAC service: if a newly-provisioned identity gets an admin-level role and it came from a SCIM/SAML mapping (not manual grant), block and require manual review. low blast radius.

jordan (product): what's the product impact? I saw a thread from support — a few paying customers couldn't get write access to their projects after migration. we should prioritize backfill so they aren't blocked.

tom (infra): plan: (1) revert Okta mapping (sophie) — immediate. (2) patch RBAC mapping to accept `team_scope` OR fall back to group->viewer mapping (emergency hotfix) — I'll take this, ETA 3h. (3) backfill existing users where we can infer scope from group names — script + dry-run — oliver, can you coordinate with support?

oliver (oncall): yep will coordinate and run the dry-run. I can also temporarily disable automated invites that trigger JIT until patch is in.

sophie (idp-admin): rolled back staging app mapping. will push to prod in ~20m after smoke tests. added an Okta policy doc snippet to the docs channel.

devops-bot: [deploy] rbac-mapper v2.14 -> canary started by @tom (infra) at 1799457060

tom (infra): deployed hotfix to canary — mapping now allows missing `team_scope` but maps to `team:<group>:viewer` and rejects any inferred admin flags. logs look clean.

maya (security): good. add an audit alert: any post-migration admin role assignment that wasn't created via an SSO manual grant should generate an incident ticket. I'll open one.

jordan (product): can we provide a short note to affected customers describing temporary steps (reinvite, or we fix for them)? I'll prepare a template.

oliver (oncall): backfill dry-run successful for 142 users (inferred scope from groups). scheduling the actual run during off-peak tonight.

sophie (idp-admin): prod mapping rolled back. manual tests pass. will follow up with the exact Okta mapping JSON and the added unit tests.

maya (security): thanks team. follow-ups: create an RBAC migration playbook, add a validation in the provisioning API for unexpected admin grants, and include `team_scope` in the onboarding contract with IdP. assigning owners: tom -> hotfix + migration script, sophie -> IdP mapping + tests, oliver -> backfill + comms, maya -> policy/audit rule.

jordan (product): adding comms draft to #support-comms and will tag @oliver for review.

sophie (idp-admin): closing loop: created ticket SEC-8243 with links to the mapping diff and the failing SAML samples. ping me if you need the sample assertions. :white_check_mark:
